name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「...Several days have already passed since the heated first round of the Murakumo Martial Festival.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Today, we will be holding the semi-final matches！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura-san, the first round has concluded, but what are your thoughts after watching it？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Oh, yeah! Every match was so intense, it got me super pumped!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「The Martial Festival is just the best, ain't it！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Win or lose, it’s got that youthful spirit to it—really makes my soul burn！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Yes, now then, let’s review today’s match results.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「In the first match of the first round, Tennouji Victoria versus Arima Rin; the winner was Victoria.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Victoria advanced to the semi-finals without a single hitch, didn't she?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Well, that’s about what you’d expect, right！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「In the second match of the first round, Igarashi Taiga versus Kazamine Setsugekka; the winner was Setsugekka.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「With this, the first semi-final match will be contested between Tennouji Victoria and Kazamine Setsugekka.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura-san, how do you see this matchup playing out？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Nah, nah, nah—this is gonna be one hell of a tough match for the first-year, Kazamine Setsugekka！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Is Victoria that much more advantageous？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「That one-year gap in experience spent at the academy? It’s way bigger than everyone thinks.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「When that turns into a two-year difference, usually, you just can’t stand a chance！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「But Setsugekka did manage to defeat the Martial Arts Division third-year, Taiga, in the first round.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, that match caught me by surprise.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Even in the Pro League, there are guys who mix martial arts with swordsmanship, but it’s pretty niche.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Most academy students have probably never fought a fencer who uses that kind of mixed martial arts style.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「So, there’s an advantage to be had there.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Though, that’s more like a trick of the trade—it rarely works on someone like Victoria, who just pushes through with raw power.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「I see. It looks like it’s going to be a grueling battle for Setsugekka.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Well then, how about that third match of the first round? Between Sonomi Arakawa and Asahi Kuki—the winner is Asahi!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Man, that was one hell of an intense match！ Even I was on the edge of my seat！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Following Setsugekka, we have another first-year from the Martial Arts Division moving on to the semifinals.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And in the highly anticipated fourth match of the first round: Momiji Suzakuin versus Shizuku Minamoto. The winner is Momiji.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「This means that in the second semifinal match, Asahi Kuki and Momiji Suzakuin will be clashing.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura, we have three first-years advancing to the semifinals! And what’s more, all three are from Takamura Class!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Haha, wait, what? That’s insane! Takamura Class is nuts! What on earth is going on this year?!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Was this unexpected even for you, Sakura?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah. I mean, nobody could’ve seen these results coming.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「But after watching them fight, I get it. Every single one of them had that look in their eyes—they were seriously strong！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「It wasn’t just luck or anything like that. The first-years simply outclassed their opponents.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「For the second semifinal match, it will be those two first-years from Takamura Class crossing blades.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Momiji was dangerously strong in her first match, so logically speaking, she’s probably the favorite.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「But, I’m gonna go out on a limb and bet on Asahi. That girl’s got guts！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Someone who pushes themselves to the absolute limit—who keeps grinding away—you can see it in their eyes. It’s different.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Asahi has that spark. I can tell—you’re the real deal！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ooh, a ringing endorsement from Sakura！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The first and second semifinal matches are both shaping up to be must-watch events！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now then, it looks like preparations are... yes, they're ready.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ladies and gentlemen, thank you so much for waiting！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The first semifinal match: Victoria Tennouji versus Setsugekka Kazamine！ The match will begin shortly！」

name: Iori
message: 「Wow, the crowd is really fired up.」
After finishing Setsugekka's vital check, I waited in front of the entrance and could hear the cheers coming from outside.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, are you nervous？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, I think I’m alright.」
Her vitals are normal, and her heart rate isn't significantly elevated. Having been through the first match, she must be getting used to the big stage.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「What is it？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If I win the Martial Festival, will you grant me one favor？」

name: Iori
message: 「Sure, I don't mind.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Really！？ Alright, I’ve got you on that promise！」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, what are you planning to ask for！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh heh, that’s a surprise for after I win.」
Ahhh, I might have jumped the gun a little…….

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting！ Now then, participants, enter！」

name: Umpire
message: 「From the East—Martial Arts Division, third year, Class A！ Tennouji, Victoriiaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now, first off, the eastern participant, Victoria, is entering！」
Victoria began her entrance from the gate on the opposite side of the stage.

name: Audience A
message: 「Vicky！ We’ve been waiting for you！」

name: Audience B
message: 「Make sure you win it all！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah！ Thanks, everybody~~~！！！」
Waving to the audience with all her might, Victoria lands a backflip. The venue is absolutely roaring with her performance.

name: Audience A
message: 「Vicky, blow that freshman away！」

name: Audience C
message: 「You’re bound to win！ We’re counting on you！」

name: Victoria
message: 「OK OK~！ There’s no such thing as impossible for me！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The excitement is immense！ Victoria is as popular as ever！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Man, she’s putting even the pros to shame here.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Rumor has it Victoria handles her own merch sales, and they’re selling out left and right.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Wait a damn minute, is she more popular than me！？ Hey everyone, buy my merch too！」

name: Audience
message: 「Vicky！ Vicky！」
The venue was now completely drowned out by the Vicky chants.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Hey, Teach.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mind if I let loose a little out there？」

name: Iori
message: 「Let loose... what are you planning on doing？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My own Jindou, that's what.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. Your own Jindou. I think that's fine.」
I had been worried she was caught up in the atmosphere and thinking of doing something strange, but it seems that was just needless anxiety.
She should just go out there and give it her all.

name: Umpire
message: 「From the West―Martial Arts Division first―year, Special Grade A, belonging to the ‘Takamura Class’！ Kazamine... Setsugekkaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa！！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, Setsugekka. Stay true to yourself out there！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You got it, I'm heading out！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Well then.」
I slowly make my way toward the stage.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And now, entering from the West, it’s Setsugekka！」
I can hear the cheers, but they aren’t as loud as they were for Victoria-senpai. Besides, there aren't really any cheers aimed at me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh, I know, I know.」
That’s right, I’m the villain here. But that’s fine.
Because I am—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A heel after all！！！」
I grip the hilt of my Origami and activate my Tenju！

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa！？ Competitor Setsugekka has activated her Tenju, even though the match hasn't even started yet！？」
I kick off the wall, leap into the air, and head straight for the broadcast booth.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Pardon me, let me borrow this for a sec！」
With that, I snatched the mic from the narrator.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Phew... Alright, you lot! Listen up for a second!!!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’ve been listening to you all go ‘Vicky this, Vicky that’ non-stop！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How about you show a little support for the first-year rookie stepping onto this stage for the first time, huh？！」
The entire venue goes quiet, everyone’s eyes locked on me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, you! Tennouji Victoria!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don’t you go getting all cocky just because you’ve got a little bit of popularity！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m the one who’s going to stop your breathing！ That’s been decided since the very dawn of time！」
In response to my challenge, Senpai Victoria grinned.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, girl！ Who in the hell are you！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hah-hah-hah-hah, I’m glad you asked! I’ll tell you!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My surname is Kazamine, and my name is Setsugekka！ The Kazamine hellion—that’s meeeeeee！！」
The whole venue responded to my spirited, soul-infused introduction.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Listen up, you guys！ I’m gonna blow Vicky away！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m gonna scatter your little flower garden to the winds, right now!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Anyway, here’s the mic back. Sorry to intrude.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh, right.」
I politely return the microphone to the narrator.

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Whoa, first-year, you really went and did it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, guhh！？ N-Nakamura Sakura-senshu……！」
I suddenly realized that the Sakura-senshu I’ve always admired was standing right in front of me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m sorry, I’m sorry! I just went and used your catchphrase without asking!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’ll pay you the royalties out of my allowance！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「No, don’t worry about that.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「More importantly, since you made such a flashy entrance, you can’t show us a pathetic match, right？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I understand. I absolutely won’t let a match of mine tarnish Sakura-senshu’s catchphrase！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, that’s the spirit. Go give it your all！」
I returned to the stage once again.
I happened to look at the western entrance.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, Teacher is angry.」
Mr. Muragaki was gritting his teeth and glaring at me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahaha~, I’m probably gonna get an earful once I get back, aren’t I...」
Well, it can’t be helped.
Because this is the Jindou I believe in.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hi~！ Kazamine-chan, come on, come on！」
Victoria-senpai was calling out to me from the stage.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Victoria-senpai, are you mad by any chance？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Non, non, it was super fun！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Thanks to you, Kazamine-chan, the venue got all hot and exciting, and I’m thrilled too！」

name: Victoria
message: 「They went to the trouble of coming to see us, so we have to make sure they enjoy it to the fullest, right！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehe, I think so too.」

name: Victoria
message: 「We might actually make a pretty good pair, don’t you think？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s true~！」
I don’t dislike Victoria-senpai’s style, either.

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay, then let’s get the crowd hyped for the match next！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, let’s do that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: （Though, I can’t guarantee it’ll go the way you want it to...！）
While keeping smiles on our faces, we secretly clashed our fighting spirits.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Uhh, my sincerest apologies. The management office is in a total panic behind the scenes due to this unforeseen situation, but...」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Hahahaha, they’ve got energy, that’s not a bad thing！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now then, preparations are complete, so let’s begin！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The highly anticipated first semifinal match between our current Toujinegi and the promising new first-year is about to begin！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Both sides, take your stance！！」
In response to the Umpire’s call, I drew my Origami.

name: Victoria
message: 「Now then, let me see what you’re capable of, Kazamine-chan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh, I won’t lose to you.」

name: Umpire
message: 「Gather the eight million gods in the Divine Assembly, and deliberate in the Divine Council. Purify the heavens and earth, purify the six senses; exorcise and purify...！」

name: Umpire
message: 「In the East corner, Tennouji Victoria！」

name: Umpire
message: 「In the West corner, Kazamine Setsugekka！」

name: Umpire
message: 「—Eight Trigrams raised high, face each other, no holds barred！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Begin the match！！」
The moment it starts, I stomp into the ground. Closing the distance to Victoria-senpai in a flash, I enter her hand-to-hand combat range.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mishima-ryuu Type Hinoe—Ugachibi！」
I drive my palm, shaped like a tiger's claw, into her flank—gouge into her Barrier Jacket as if to scrape away the flesh.

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa！ That’s some crazy rapid speed！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「―Type Kou―Edanagi！！」
Lowering my stance until I’m practically hugging the ground, I dodge Victoria-senpai’s slash and unleash a spinning kick aimed at her pivot leg.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Wow, heavy…！ Her center of gravity is way too low…！）
Despite the clean hit, Victoria-senpai only wavered slightly.
The impact should have been enough to knock her over, and yet—！

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah！ Gotcha~！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa-ah！？」
Her crushing blow bears down on me, and I roll along the ground to evade without a second thought.
Victoria-senpai’s strike, slamming into the earth, shatters the reinforced ceramic tiles covering the stage into dust.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa, Setsugekka-senshu, that was a close one！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Every single hit from Victoria is heavy as hell; one clean shot and it’s game over！」

name: Setsugekka
message: （One hit and it's over? I’ve already landed two on her, though！）
Feeling the injustice of it all, I scramble to my feet.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm… you’re faster than you were in the first match. Did you prepare some counter-strategies for Vicky？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't be silly, I didn't do anything like that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don't really hold you in that high a regard, Victoria-senpai.」
I pull up the corner of my mouth to provoke her.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hehehe, you’ve got a mean look, Kazamine-chan. You’re starting to look a bit like Nakamura Sakura-senshu.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That is the highest compliment I could ever receive！！」
I latch onto Victoria-senpai once more.
Dodging the blade Victoria-senpai unleashes, I throw my whole body into her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mishima-ryuu Type Tsuchinoe, Houda Chouchuu！！」
I rushed forward, using my Tenju at full capacity. Focusing all that momentum and my entire body weight into the point of my elbow, I aimed to drive it straight through Victoria-senpai’s sternum！！

name: Setsugekka
message: （Got her... or so I thought！？）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughhhggghh！！」
I barely managed to block the incoming blade of Victoria-senpai with my Origami.

name: Victoria
message: 「Phew, that one made my chest go a little numb！」
A clean hit with the Houda Chouchuu has enough power to send a grown man flying over ten meters.
And she just took it head-on and said it made her a little numb.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Just how tough are you, anyway～...！ ）
Senpai started pushing down on the Origami that was holding her back.

name: Victoria
message: 「Come on, come on～, I’m going to flatten you～！！」
Tremendous pressure bore down on my arms.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh... grrrghhh, damn you～...！」
I was being crushed helplessly, as if I were being compressed by a giant industrial press.

name: Naruko
message: 「Now then, Victoria is applying immense pressure in this blade lock！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「She’d better get out of there soon. She’s got no chance of winning a power struggle against Victoria！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh, hehehe, that’s what you think, isn’t it...！ 」
But that’s where you’re wrong, Sakura-senshu. Even I have confidence in my own strength, you know.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Alright then, I suppose it’s about time... to wake you up！）
Come out, my other self—！
Something jet-black, scalding, and ferocious flowed into me.
Just like before, I stopped resisting and accepted “it.”

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa, haaa... haaa, haaaaaaahhhh...！！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm... Unnnngh...！？」
The inner god, Mizuchi, began to roar and rage within me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...A simple pushing match is just so unrefined.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But precisely because of that... I mean, I absolutely refuse to lose！！！」
I had been on the verge of being crushed.
But from that point on, my blade began to push back, inch by inch...！

name: Victoria
message: 「Guh... nngghhh...！！」

name: Naruko
message: 「O... Oh, ohhh！ Setsugekka-senshu is actually pushing Victoria-senshu back！！！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「No way…！ She actually has enough power to go toe-to-toe with Victoria！？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Fufu, there it is, Kazamine-chan’s Berserker mode…！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Too bad, I haven’t lost control… not this time！！」
There was a specific reason why I hadn’t called upon my inner god, Mizuchi, from the start.
That reason being, I wanted to see how well I could hold my own against Victoria-senpai using only my raw ability.
But I hadn’t even been a match for her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But, I’m glad I did, because now I know…！」
If I hadn't been able to control my inner god, my Martial Festival would have definitely ended right there.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Which means… that everything I’ve done with Muragaki-sensei was absolutely not！ In vain！！」
With every ounce of my strength, I sent Victoria-senpai flying.

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa, don’t tell me, you’ve learned to control the Berserk…！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh, that’s exactly it.」
I give her a bold, defiant grin.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm, you do seem pretty normal. Your language has gotten a bit rough, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「T-that can’t be helped！」
Since I could properly control my inner god, I was no longer losing my consciousness.
It was just that, for some reason, my personality became a little more ferocious, or perhaps just rougher than usual.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Well, everyone gets a foul mouth when they’re angry, right?）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Now then, you really did a number on me earlier, Vicky！」

name: Victoria
message: 「What？ Which part are you talking about？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Trying to crush me flat, that’s what！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, don’t worry. I was planning to let up at just the right moment.」

name: Victoria
message: 「If I’d actually crushed you, the audience would’ve been totally put off~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don’t screw with me！ What kind of fencer is happy about being held back！！」
I strike at Victoria-senpai. Sometimes with my fists, sometimes with my legs, and then with my Origami.
Mixing strikes and slashes, I corner Victoria-senpai.

name: Setsugekka
message: （I can do this… I’m not being pushed back…！！）
Until a moment ago, striking her felt like I was hitting a steel pillar; it didn't budge at all.
But it’s different now. If I strike, it resonates, and if I slash, my opponent actually moves.
The Iwa, which hadn't moved an inch, began to retreat little by little.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uraaaaaaaahhhhhhh！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mishima-ryuu Type Kanoe: Hajoushou！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ngaaaaaah！？」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Victoria has taken a clean hit from Setsugekka and been blown away！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Hey, hey, she was slammed into the wall without even bouncing！？」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「I’m worried about the damage！ Can Victoria stand up！?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Both of them have absurd amounts of Tenju dumped into physical strength！ They're absolute monsters when it comes to mental resonance levels.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「This is turning into a power struggle that would make even the pros turn pale…！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky… Vicky, are you okay！？」
…I hear a familiar voice.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Answer me, Vicky！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh… sorry. I think I might’ve lost consciousness for a second.」
Shizuku's voice could be heard through the ultra-compact microphone.
—An incredible shock that my Barrier Jacket couldn't fully absorb. Before I knew it, I was somehow managing to stand at the edge of the stage.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Your consciousness has returned to normal levels… Vicky, can you still go？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Of course！ I can't be eliminated in a place like this！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vitals are normal, and the Barrier Jacket is… okay.」
Perhaps thanks to hearing Shizuku's calm voice, my racing heart rate is slowly beginning to settle down.

name: Victoria
message: 「Whew… I let my guard down. To think I’d take a clean hit from Kazamine-chan. How much damage is it？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「You might have lost about an eighth from that one.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Really！？ She shaved that much off my Barrier Jacket in one hit？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Berserk Kazamine-chan is a monster.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「It’s fine; compared to you, it’s not that much.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hahaha, that’s biased.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I-It’s an objective fact…」

name: Shizuku
message: 「More importantly, Vicky, let's switch to Plan C2. That should definitely make it easier for you to fight.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Plan C2, roger！」
Shizu knows me even better than I know myself.
She watches me, cherishes me, and acts for my sake.
So all I have to do is trust Shizu and move.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, I'm constantly monitoring the condition of your Origami and your vitals.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「You don't need to worry about the rear at all. Go wild as much as you like.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah, I know. Watch over me, okay！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Yes, of course. I'll back you up with everything I've got.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, Shizu.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「What is it...？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Thanks for being my Second.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「...Idiot.」

name: Shizuku
message: idiot.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Now then, how about we get revenge time started！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Sorry to keep you waaaiting, Kazamine-chan.」
Victoria-senpai readies the Origami in her hand.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey there, Vicky-chan. Manage to get a little rest？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Playing the heel is really starting to suit you, Kazamine-chan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh heh heh, indeed it does, indeed it does.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Though with a face that cute, you're not scary at all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's off-limits！ That's the thing I'm most self-conscious about！！」
Irritation slowly wells up and overflows. It becomes a new source of energy, igniting a fire deep inside me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Tch, every last one of you making a fool of me... Fear me a little already！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And damn well revere meee！！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「……Heh, I’ve got your number！」
Responding to my attack, Victoria-senpai landed a perfect counter-attack.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Damn it, you think I’m just gonna let you get away with that！！」
Once again, she unleashes a thrust in sync with my movements.

name: Setsugekka
message: （What is this, everything is being dodged……！？）
But I can’t afford to let up. If I don't close the distance, I can't land a hit.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I have to do this……！」
Feinting, I dive into Victoria-senpai’s inner guard.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hehehe, I won’t let you get close~！」
Saying that, she retreats exactly as much as I advance—
I barely manage to block Victoria-senpai’s intense slash.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You damn brat～～～！！」
I charge forward recklessly, but—

name: Victoria
message: 「Come on, come on, Kazamine-chan, over here~ follow the sound of the claps~♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, you bastard～～～！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh！？」
The moment I try to close the gap, a slash rains down as if to crush my face.
Even when I manage to parry, a second and third strike follow, never letting me get within range.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh my, Victoria-senshu has switched to a distance-based strategy！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Her opponent is a martial arts user, after all. It’s a logical move.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「But…… I didn't think Victoria was the type to care about range or strategy.」

name: Setsugekka
message: （Wait, it’s because Shizuku-senpai is there as her Second……！）
Victoria-senpai might be obsessed with winning, but she isn't the type to obsess over how she fights. That’s what Muragaki-sensei said.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……You’re acting pretty underhanded, aren't you, Senpai? It’s real low of you to pick on your junior like this！」

name: Victoria
message: 「It’s fine, once I see a path to victory, I’ll be sure to give you a moment to shine too, Kazamine-chan♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay, thank you so much~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「As if I’d ever say that, you moron！」
Stomp, stomp, I pound my feet against the ground.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If it’s come to this, I’ll latch onto you even if it kills me！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, geez！ Just let me get close！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Noooo wayyyy！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「But, it’d be a pity to just send you packing like that~！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I’ll give you a little chance…！」
The aura surrounding Victoria-senpai shifted.

name: Victoria
message: 「Come now, listen closely, you impudent, unruly, and unhealthy scoundrels who dare to set yourselves against the Shogun！」

name: Victoria
message: 「With this Okita-kun here, I won’t let you do as you please！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「There it isooooo！ Victoria-senshu’s signature move, the stance of the Multi-Strike Flurry！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: （Oh, so that’s what she meant by a chance…！）
Victoria-senpai doesn’t dodge while delivering her introductory speech. She takes everything on her Barrier Jacket.
That means, in other words, I can attack her as much as I want.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In that case, I won’t hold back from clobbering you…！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eat this… Mishima-ryuu Type Tsuchinoe, Houda Chouchuu！！！」
I thought I’d definitely caught her in the torso, but—

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, everybody~！ How are you feeling right noooow！？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah！ Eighteen Blades！！！」
Numerous blades surfaced around Victoria-senpai, and the excited crowd broke into a roar of cheers.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait… hold on, you took zero damage from that！？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Fufun, heroes are invincible while delivering their catchphrases, you know！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s cheating!!!」
I scrambled to retreat—but Victoria-senpai was a split-second faster.

name: Victoria
message: 「Here I come！ Profound Illusion, Sonic Rushhhhhhh！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uwaaaaaaaah！！！」
I flailed my blade in a desperate trance and managed to deflect a few, but all the remaining stabs bit deep into my Barrier Jacket.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ohhh, Setsugekka-senshu couldn’t dodge Victoria-senshu’s multi-strike flurry!!!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Is she down！？ Can she still stand, Setsugekka-senshu！！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「No way, that’s impossible！ No one has ever stood back up after taking that from Victoria at the Martial Festival...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Geez, shut up already.」
The impact of the stab pierces through my entire body, and a sharp pain courses through me.
But my Barrier Jacket hasn’t given out yet.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, just watch and keep quiet...！」
I can still—fight.

name: Victoria
message: 「Heh, you’re still so energetic even after taking Okita-kun’s finishing move head-on...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh... so that was Okita-kun’s finishing move, was it?」
We cross blades and enter a deadlock.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, did anyone die？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If that’s all your finishing move is, then Okita-kun isn’t much of a big deal either！」

name: Victoria
message: 「HEY girl, I’d really like you to take that back...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I don’t care what you say about me, but I won’t forgive you for mocking Okita-kun...！！」
A clear look of anger surfaces on my senior’s face, which had held an easygoing smile since the start of the match.

name: Victoria
message: 「Okita-kun is my hero...！！」
Under Victoria-senpai’s fierce push, my Origami—Momijigari—lets out a sinister, creaking groan.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, that’s the look I wanted to see, Senpai...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don’t care if he’s a hero or whatever.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If you just keep grinning the whole time, it’s no fun for the person fighting you！！」
I channel my rage into power through my Tenju and push Victoria-senpai back.

name: Victoria
message: 「I see, so it was on purpose... that’s some dirty tactics you’re using there, Kazamine-chan...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Mocking what someone holds dear just to provoke them... you’re a disgrace to the Kazamine swordsmen！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Fine by me！ I’m choosing to play the heel here！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「W-wait, the ground under them... the tiles are cracking and caving in！！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Damn... you barely ever see a slugfest this brutal, even in the Pro League！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Okay, okay, if that’s how it’s going to be, Kazamine-chan, then I’m not holding back anymore...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, please don’t...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m doing this so I won't have any regrets after losing！」
I shift my axis to slide Victoria-senpai's blade aside, creating a slight opening before swinging to slash at her torso.

name: Victoria
message: 「Ngh... Fucking YOU！！！」
Victoria-senpai, not to be outdone, swings her blade and chips away at my Barrier Jacket.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That hurts, you bastard！！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Evil—instant—SLASH！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa, what a fierce exchange of blows!!!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「This could go either way now...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can't afford to lose in a place like this！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I promised... that I’d definitely win and face Momiji in the finals!!!」

name: Victoria
message: 「I’m the same way！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Because this match isn't just about me！」

name: Victoria
message: 「That’s why I absolutely cannot lose！！」
We trade blows... chipping away at each other, striking each other, yet neither of us lets up.

name: Victoria
message: 「...Hey, Kazamine-chan！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What？」

name: Victoria
message: 「What kind of person is Suzakuin-chan to you, Kazamine-chan？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Geez, I wonder.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「She’s my friend, my rival... the person I want to stay by my side forever.」
At first, Kei-chan told me she was a goal to defeat, and I’d approached Momiji with that intent.
But before I knew it—she’d become something more than that.

name: Victoria
message: 「Fufufu, so you found it too, Kazamine-chan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Found what？」

name: Victoria
message: 「My other half. I found mine, too.」

name: Victoria
message: 「The person who’s always watched over me, helped me, and cheered me on from right behind me.」

name: Victoria
message: 「...For that person’s sake, I can give it my all.」
Without a preamble, Victoria-senpai makes her blade hover.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I see, so you're serious.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then I won't hold anything back either...！」
Tenju surging through every corner of my body. Heat rises through me as if I'm engulfed in crimson flames.

name: Victoria & Setsugekka
message: 「Shatter！ Sonic Ruuuuuush！！！！" "Mishima-ryuu Secret Art！！ Type Mizunoto: Hatou Ranbu！！！！」
In an instant, dozens of thrusts erupt from Victoria-senpai. But I'm not losing out either.
Fists, elbows, kicks, and slashes. Every martial technique of Mishima-ryuu overlaps into a raging wave, crashing down on Victoria-senpai—！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why you—go doooooown！！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「In the end, justice wiiiiiiins！！！」
Unable to resist the tremendous cheers echoing from above, I was watching the match from a corner of the spectator stands.
And what I ended up witnessing was—

name: Momiji
message: （They're both monsters...！）
Setsugekka and Victoria-san were trading blows on equal footing.
The entire venue is shaking from their ferocious clash.
If an ordinary swordsman got caught in that barrage, they'd be sunk instantly.

name: Momiji
message: 「Even I don't know how long I'd last against that...」
Shingan no Kiwamete reads every possible move to maximize my own lines of attack while minimizing the opponent's.
However, that's strictly a matter of probability; accidental factors outside my predicted lines aren't accounted for.
Which is why Victoria-san was my natural enemy.
Against a swordsman with a devastating strike, there's always the chance of going down to a single lucky punch.

name: Momiji
message: 「I thought I knew, but that really is a threat...」
Setsugekka has grown enough to stand shoulder to shoulder with even someone like Victoria-san.
She too is a massive threat, and yet I also feel happy that she's grown this far.

name: Momiji
message: 「She was annoying at first, sure... but being chased around by her wasn't actually that bad, I guess.」
I feel like I've changed a lot over these past few months.
Maybe it's because Setsugekka sought me out.
That's precisely why I want to answer what she seeks.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Make sure you win your way up here, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why you—go doooooown！！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「In the end, justice wiiiiiiins！！！」
Kazamine-san and Vicky have both abandoned their guard, slugging it out at full power.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, no... Pull back for now...！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Condition Yellow—at this rate, your Barrier Jacket won't hold...！」
I called out desperately to Vicky, but my voice didn't reach her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm gonna beat you, Senpai, and make it to the finals—aaaah！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I won't let you！ I'm the one going to the finals！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I'm not alone！ I have Shizu with me！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I'm fighting this match together with Shizu, now that we've made up！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「So I refuse to lose！ Not for anything！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I don't want to do anything that would leave me unable to face Shizu！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I believe in the me that Shizu believed in！！！」
Taking the full brunt of Kazamine-san's attacks, Vicky didn't back down an inch.
Vicky was fighting.
Not merely to win the match, and not for the spectators.
For me, and for the version of herself that I believed in.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky...！」
A piece of the Spirit-Type Armament Vicky was wearing shattered and flew off. Her Barrier Jacket had reached its limit.

name: Shizuku
message: 「...Honestly, there's just no helping you, Vicky.」
With a wry smile, I switched off my mic. She wouldn't be needing my advice anymore.
Still, I was fine with that. Vicky recognized me as her Second, and she was thinking of me.
Being able to join hands with her like that and step into this match together made me happier than anything.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky... Fight the rest of this match however your heart desires.」
And no matter what the outcome may be, I'll stay right by her side through it—.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hah, hah, haa, hah...！」
Trading blows for as long as our breath held out. Taking massive damage, both of us battered and ragged.

name: Victoria
message: 「Huff, huff... aaah, hah...！」
...Even so, Victoria-senpai and I were still standing.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Th-This is... Just what can I even say...！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「My apologies. The sheer intensity of this back-and-forth battle had me so captivated that I completely forgot to commentate...！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Nah, can't blame ya. Even I couldn't get a word out.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Both competitors are already battered from head to toe. Now, how will this play out！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You've got... way more guts than I thought, Senpai...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hee-hee... Kazamine-chan, too, huh...！」
My head is spinning. The edges of my vision are blurring slightly. Both mentally and physically, the end is near.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「After taking that many hits, surely you’re at your limit too, Senpai...？」

name: Victoria
message: 「No way, I’ve still got plenty to spare...！ Kazamine-chan, your legs are all wobbly, are you really okay？」
I wonder how much I’ve managed to wear down her Barrier Jacket. How much longer until Senpai finally goes down?
A faint sense of despair washes over me.

name: Setsugekka
message: （…Ridiculous, no way am I losing here！）
I steel myself again.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, Victoria-senpai, you must be struggling too, so I suppose I should finish you off soon...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ah, no fair, not that one！」

name: Victoria
message: 「‘Finish you off！’ is Okita-kun’s catchphrase when he defeats an enemy, you can’t steal that！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Kazamine-chan, you’re the heel, so you should be saying things like ‘I’ll kill you!’ or ‘Die, scum!’ or something like that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahaha, you’re so energetic, Senpai...」
A smile escaped me involuntarily. To think that even now, she’s still hung up on being a hero.

name: Victoria
message: 「So then！ Listen well, you insolent, disrespectful, weak Kazamine-chan who dares to defy the Shogun！」

name: Victoria
message: 「With this dynamic duo of Tennouji Victoria and Shizu here, I won’t let you do whatever you please！」
…This is probably the final blow.
Even Victoria-senpai shouldn't have any strength left.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If that’s how it is, I’ll make sure to go out with a bang...！！」
I focus every ounce of my strength into one single point—my fist.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, everybody~！ How are you feeling right noooow！？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah！ Twentyeeeeeee-one！！！」
Blades radiating rainbow-colored light emerged, filling the space around Victoria-senpai.

name: Victoria
message: 「This is the end！！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Mystic Illusion, Sonic Ruuuuuuuush！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「…Mishima-ryuu Type Kanoto, Ginjun！！」
Ginjun is a parrying technique used to deflect an opponent’s strikes or thrusts, altering their trajectory to create an opening for retreat or evasion.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Damn iiiiiit！！！」
Amidst a storm of thrusts that felt like it would last for eternity. I connect, and keep connecting, the thin threads like silk—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guh... reach herrrrgghhh!!!」
While having her remaining Barrier Jacket carved away.
―I grabbed Victoria―senpai’s dominant hand.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehe... hahahaha, I caught you...！！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, my god...！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ohhhhhhh— wait, Setsugekka-senshu, is this...！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「She dodged every one of Victoria-senshu’s attacks and grabbed her arm！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright, Victoria-senpai, are you ready for this...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m about at my limit too, so let’s end this right here...！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Let go, I said let gooooooooo！！！」
Raging like a giant bull, Victoria-senpai was thrashing about and throwing punches without a care for her dignity.
My thinned Barrier Jacket couldn't fully dampen the force, and sparks flew in my field of vision.
But I wouldn't let go of that hand, no matter what...！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...For the finish, I’ll play by your style, Senpai.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This is the end, Hero！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m going to scatter your little flower garden right here and now！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「―Mishima―ryuu Secret Technique, Type Mizunoto: Banzetsu！！！」
I poured every ounce of strength in my body into my fist. From point-blank range, with no way for her to escape, toward Victoria-senpai.
I unleashed a final, decisive strike—.
The haze cleared from my vision, and sound returned to the world.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa... haa...」
I look around while gasping for air.
And when I realize, I’m the only one left standing—

name: Umpire
message: 「Match over！！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「The Eastern side, Tennouji Victoria’s Barrier Jacket is confirmed to have vanished！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Therefore, the victory goes to the Western side, Kazamine Setsugekka！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It’s decideddddddddddddddddddddddd！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The first semi-final match, the victor is Setsugekka-senshu！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Ooh—！ That was an amazing match, Kazamine！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura-san, a brilliant victory that defied all expectations！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Victoria is a heavy hitter even among the past Toujinegi. Who could’ve predicted a first-year student would take her down！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「This is without a doubt a monumental bout that will go down in the history of the Murakumo Martial Festival！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uh... I won, didn’t I？」
As I stand there dazed, someone throws their arms around me from behind.

name: Iori
message: 「You did it！！ Setsugekka！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, Muragaki-sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「You won, Setsugekka！ That puts you in the finals！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um... Sensei, you aren’t mad？」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ What are you talking about？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You know, for me grabbing the mic and cutting a heel promo before the match...」

name: Iori
message: 「Who cares about that！ Let’s just celebrate the victory right now！」
...Ah, that’s right.
I really did win. I beat Victoria-senpai.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ha, haha... I really did win.」

name: Iori
message: 「You held your own, and you fought well！」

name: Iori
message: 「That was a magnificent match, Setsugekka...！」
For some reason, Muragaki-sensei is tearing up.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「C-come on now, if Muragaki-sensei gets this happy, there won’t be any room left for me to be happy!」

name: Iori
message: 「My bad, but congratulations, truly！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, thank you.」
Well, glad I didn't get chewed out for it.
There was one more thing on my mind, so I looked around, glancing here and there.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um, where’s Victoria-senpai？」

name: Iori
message: 「Over there, look.」
The direction Sensei was pointing—Shizuku-senpai was helping a battered Victoria-senpai up to her feet.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「U-um... Victoria-senpai, are you alright！？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Phew... that last one really packed a punch~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ah, okay, okay, it was just a match, you know.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m sorry too, Shizuku-senpai.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「It’s fine. Vicky seems satisfied, after all.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah！ I was totally satisfied！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-if you say so, then that’s good, but...」
I can’t help but feel like I did something bad, and I can’t find the right words to say.

name: Victoria
message: 「Come on, Kazamine-chan, the winner has to smile！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Otherwise, the people who came to watch will be disappointed!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-yes！」
I force a smile onto my face.

name: Victoria
message: 「Yup, great！ See you later, then, Kazamine-chan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um, Victoria-senpai！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hmm？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Will you... spar with me again sometime...？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Of course！ In the end, justice wins, after all！」

name: Victoria
message: 「I hope you and Suzakuin-chan can get close too, Kazamine-chan.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Like my other half and me！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahaha, that’s true.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Hey, Vicky, what on earth are you telling Kazamine-san...！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Shiz is so cute when she’s embarrassed~」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Honestly, you’re such an idiot, Vicky.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Ow-ow-ow-ow, p-please be a little gentler!」
Victoria-senpai and Shizuku-senpai walked off the Martial Festival stage together, happily bantering with each other.
